A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the global public good nature of agricultural biotechnology depends upon a narrative that blends the values of different stakeholder groups, and is supported by a set of narratives that can be used to facilitate debate and overcome gaps and contradictions.
the narrative approach to risk communication and deliberation has the potential to help people to articulate and resolve their differences.
the narrative framework provides a way of thinking about risk as value.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the value of a technology, such as agricultural biotechnology, cannot be reduced to one value.
the global biotechnology discussion needs to be reframed as one about value.
